recommendation_short: Mixed — uphold township/school portions; revoke forest/catchment portions
recommendation_full: Recommendation varies by allottee/purpose. Township and school extensions (e.g. Elburgon township, Michinda School): uphold the status quo (area settled/occupied). Portions still under forest, and the Bararget/Elburgon water-catchment excision: Revoke and maintain as forest. Verify each allottee against the Vol II Annex 1/18 entries.
remarks: Kapsita ~3300 ha duly surveyed/registered/titled; Bararget (Elburgon) ~2800 ha excision partially halted because the area is the region's only water catchment.
source_citation: Ndung'u Report Vol III p156; Vol II Annex 1 pp7-8 / Annex 18 p683

recommendation_full: Conflicting recommendations recorded. LN 292 of 1994 (farming, 'excision for private gain'): Revoke. Verify which legal notice governs each plot.
remarks: Phases I, II and III; area is settled.
source_citation: Vol II Annex 18 p681; Annex 1 pp9-11

recommendation_short: Mixed by allottee — revoke individuals/county; legalise public schools; review catchment
recommendation_full: Recommendation varies by allottee/purpose. Individual allocations and Bomet County Council (tea development): Revoke. Songiroi Girls Secondary School (school development): Legalise excision. Landless settlement at Olenguruone (LN 127/1988): Review to set aside catchment areas / uphold the status quo but exclude ecologically sensitive areas.
remarks: Olenguruone sits in South Western Mau (LN 127/1988); Kiptagich is an Eastern Mau extension (LN 142/2001). Part of the area was taken up by wealthy individuals including former PS for Internal Security Zakayo Cheruiyot.
source_citation: Ndung'u Report Vol III p155; Vol II Annex 18 p678 / Annex 1 p10

recommendation_short: Needs manual review — no per-scheme recommendation located
recommendation_full: No legal notice or recommendation for the Kibunja excision itself exists in the report. Vol III p156 records it as a PROPOSED (not gazetted) Mt Londiani excision of 124.9 ha to resettle people displaced by the expansion of Mary Mount School at Kibunja Trading Centre; the report states a Gazette Notice was proposed but does not cite a number. For CONTEXT only, the gazetted Mt Londiani excisions recorded in Annexes 1-2 are DISTINCT from Kibunja: (1) Elburgon - LN 198 of 1967, 44.92 ha, settlement, uphold the status quo; (2) Londiani Town extension - 17.37 ha (1992), Revoke; (3) Sabatia business plots - 19.98 ha (1993), Legalize; (4) Maji Mazuri / Makutano Police Station - 4.00 ha (1993), Revoke. None of these is the Kibunja excision - do NOT treat any as Kibunja's legal notice. Verify against source.
remarks: Mt Londiani proposed excision ~124.9 ha; Mary Mount School displacement at Kibunja Trading Centre. Related (distinct) gazetted Mt Londiani excisions: Elburgon LN 198/1967; Londiani Town; Sabatia; Maji Mazuri.
source_citation: Ndung'u Report Vol III p156; Vol II Annex 18 pp679-680
